title: Both sides queen: the first queen's move

D0.outcome: Explains that when both sides will queen, the first new queen may capture the other pawn or command its queening square.

D1.outcome: Counts a two-pawn race and states who queens first and whether that queen controls the other's queening square.

D2.outcome: In unlabeled races, chooses the line that lands on the controlling square instead of grabbing material.

D3.outcome: Predicts how a check or capture at the queening square changes the outcome.

misconceptions: Counting the moves to queen settles the race.
conditions: Both pawns are free; the first new queen must command the other's queening square.
contrasts: The same race where capturing the pawn loses the queen's control of the key square.
Counting moves but missing a check or a capture on the queening square.
An extra far-away king move that is not needed.
